lessons.title: Weeks 1–3: code, pages, design, and data
prerequisites: Complete the web foundations or know how to open the project, edit a file, and verify the result in a browser. No previous commercial experience is required.
objectives: Turn Weeks 1–3: code, pages, design, and data into concrete, measurable decisions that can be applied to a real store.
Turn a navigable site with a secure catalog and clean build into concrete, measurable decisions that can be applied to a real store.

Turn Create routes and components, apply a responsive design system, model Supabase, and prove security, states, and build before adding commerce. into concrete, measurable decisions that can be applied to a real store.

blocks.text: Create routes and components, apply a responsive design system, model Supabase, and prove security, states, and build before adding commerce. A sound decision always connects the customer need, the visual or commercial rule, its implementation in the site, and an observable signal. This prevents vague preferences and copied tactics whose purpose is not understood.

blocks.title: Simple analogy
blocks.text: Weeks 1–3: code, pages, design, and data is like arranging a physical shop: every color, space, message, or offer should help a visitor understand where they are, what they can buy, and why they can trust the next step.

Create routes and components, apply a responsive design system, model Supabase, and prove security, states, and build before adding commerce. Name the precise problem before selecting a tool. Observe context, device, intent, and customer objections. Then write a hypothesis that links one change to an expected result without presenting that hypothesis as established fact.

To master Weeks 1–3: code, pages, design, and data, first build a minimal version with explicit rules, then inspect it on mobile and desktop. Contrast normal, empty, long, and error cases. Quality comes from a coherent testable system, not from accumulating visual effects or promotional messages.

This lesson delivers a navigable site with a secure catalog and clean build. It must record the starting situation, decision, expected evidence, and safety limit. Compare behavior and before/after metrics over enough time while accounting for traffic, costs, and satisfaction.
